result.headline: Throttle command dropped 49% to 0 at t=48.9 s and stayed zero; aircraft then lost about 30 m of altitude.
result.explanation: The propulsion loop (throttle, output ch2) went to zero at t=48.945 s with no recorded mode change or event, and it never recovered. The recording does not show who or what commanded it.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT propulsion.throttle was varying, then held 0 from t=48.945 s to the end of the recording (17.402 s, 47 samples)
evidence.shows: Throttle fell to 0 and never recovered. No mode-change event explains it (events show only two start-up warnings).

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[2]] was varying, then held 1100 from t=49.442 s to the end of the recording (16.868 s, 52 samples)
evidence.shows: The throttle output channel followed the throttle to the 1100 us minimum, about 0.19 s after the throttle drop, and then froze.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[2]] follows propulsion.throttle (correlation 0.982 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: ch2 is the throttle (propulsion) channel, so the output obeyed its command and the fault is upstream of the output.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good at t=56.041 s: median 49.388 before, 23.183 after m (31.5x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Altitude fell from about 50 m to 18 m after the throttle cut, which is the physical consequence.

evidence.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[pitch] diverged from its setpoint from t=48.973 to 49.624 s (peak |error| 8.999 deg)
evidence.shows: Pitch error began 28 ms after the throttle drop, so it is an effect.

checked.check: Sequence of who left baseline first around t=48-52 s
checked.result: The roll setpoint moved first at 48.715 s as part of a manoeuvre. Throttle left baseline at 48.945 s, ch2 at 49.135 s, then attitude, velocity and altitude.
Throttle went from 50 to 0 and ch2 from 1500 to 1100 us. Attitude, velocity and yaw tracking then degraded.

checked.check: Roll setpoint and roll tracking over the whole recording
checked.result: The roll setpoint swings between -45 and +42 deg and comes back, so it is manoeuvring. Typical roll tracking error is 2.5 deg, so the roll loop follows its setpoint. No sustained roll fault.

checked.check: Compare at the roll setpoint shift, t=5.57 s
checked.result: There was no frozen output and no tracking degradation. The change is a commanded roll manoeuvre.
Only start-up warnings at t=0.175 s (Low voltage, Sensor helth). No earlier cases exist to compare with.

effects.why: The output obeyed the zero throttle command.

hypotheses.claim: Autopilot, failsafe or operator logic commanded throttle to zero at 48.945 s.
hypotheses.because: Throttle left baseline first and ch2 followed 0.19 s later, with no recorded event. Both are commanded or estimated values, not the physical motor.

hypotheses.claim: The throttle channel or ESC failed physically.
